material.value: Where can a CI-run harness live inside rust/crates/mod-host (no test files per gm rules; rust/gate is out of ownership), and does acceptance gate 0 failed refer to rust/gate checks we cannot edit?
material.witness_evidence: ci.yml runs only cargo run -p oscraft-spike and oscraft-gate (no cargo test). A CI-run harness for mod-host needs edits to rust/gate, rust/crates/spike or .github, all outside ownership. dispatch 1792147830329-500-cf214ccc5f0f295b
